It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 64.323 (Andre egeninvesteringsselskaper); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 19 815. CEO: Julie Katrine Drønen; board chair: Ivar Terje Drønen; auditor: FORVIS MAZARS AS.
